metadata.explanation: Task requires cloning the instructor-embedding repository to /home/user/instructor-embedding. Evaluator checks: (1) directory exists (0.2 points), (2) it's a git repository with .git folder (0.2 points), (3) contains key files like README.md, setup.py, and LICENSE (0.3 points), (4) remote URL matches https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding (0.3 points). Custom getter executes bash commands to verify directory structure, file presence, and git remote URL.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.2 for directory existence, 0.2 for valid git repository, 0.3 for required files present, 0.3 for correct remote URL

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: directory exists, is git repo, contains required files, and has correct remote URL
Getter properly extracts git remote URL using 'git -C <repo_path> remote get-url origin' command (git_repo.py:42-47)
Metric correctly compares remote URL with expected value 'https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding' (git_repo.py:57-88)
URL normalization logic handles different git URL formats (https vs git@, trailing .git) for robust comparison
Correct parameter handling for type='rule': metric directly accesses expected.get('required_files') and expected.get('remote_url')
Scoring breakdown is logical: 0.2 directory + 0.2 git repo + 0.3 files + 0.3 remote URL = 1.0 with appropriate partial credit
File matching uses substring logic which works correctly for standard repo files (.git, README.md, setup.py, LICENSE)
No postconfig needed as cloned repository persists on disk and doesn't require UI state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider using exact filename matching instead of substring matching for required files to avoid potential false positives (e.g., 'README' matching 'README.md.backup')
Minor: The find command uses maxdepth 2, which should be sufficient for standard repo files but could miss deeply nested LICENSE files in unusual repo structures
